definition: Neuro-sama is an artificial intelligence (AI) VTuber.
details: She was created by the pseudonymous programmer Vedal and livestreams on his Twitch and Bilibili channels. Her speech and personality are powered by a large language model (LLM) chatbot that is combined with a computer-animated avatar and a text-to-speech voice, allowing her to communicate with viewers. Vedal is the third most-subscribed Twitch streamer of all time. Neuro-sama began as a bot solely designed to play the rhythm game osu!. She debuted with speech capabilities and an avatar on Twitch on 19 December 2022. She rapidly gained popularity before receiving a two-week ban in January 2023, which was widely attributed to her uttering hate speech, such as Holocaust denial. Afterwards, Vedal said that he had strengthened and improved filters on her speech. During 2023, her online content expanded with Neuro-sama playing other video games, such as Minecraft, reacting to videos, singing and doing karaoke, collaborating with Vedal and other human streamers, and being joined by an AI VTuber "sister" known as Evil Neuro. Her speech and personality come from an LLM chatbot combined with a computer-animated avatar and text-to-speech voice, letting her interact with viewers.

tiers.eli5: She is a computer character on a live stream who talks with the audience using an AI chatbot, an animated face, and a synthetic voice, like a cartoon host who chats in real time.
tiers.practitioner: Streamers and developers study Neuro-sama as an example of combining an LLM chatbot with an avatar and text-to-speech for live audience interaction. A pitfall is that a live LLM-driven persona must stay coherent while responding to unpredictable viewer input.
tiers.paperLevel: An AI VTuber whose speech and personality are produced by a large language model chatbot coupled with a computer-animated avatar and text-to-speech voice. Known limit: as a single live system, it is described by its components rather than a formal specification.

explainer.example: Viewers type messages in a Twitch chat, and the LLM generates replies that the avatar speaks aloud with a synthetic voice.
